text:
Anya K: Heads-up — PR #742 for quantization examples is ready but needs SDK snippet alignment and a small UX text change. pinging docs + eng-ml.

Mike L: On it. Which SDK version should snippets target? we changed batch API in 0.12.0.

Anya K: Target 0.12.x. PR currently shows old `batch_send` call. Need code samples using `with client.batch():` and a kv-prefetch note. I'll paste the snippet below.

Jordan R: If you paste the snippet here I can run the linter. Also flagging a link in the migration guide that points to an internal draft (404 risk).

Anya K: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
with client.batch() as b:
    b.send("generate", model="rw-v2-q4f", prompt="Summarize the doc in 2 bullets")
```

Mike L: looks fine but change model name to `rw-v2-q4f16` (we renamed q4f -> q4f16 in the registry). Also add a short note recommending `kv_prefetch=True` for short prompts to avoid cold-start token cost.

Jordan R: I'll push a tiny commit to the PR to update the snippet + repair the migration link to the public kv-prefetch page. @docs-bot can you run the spellcheck & linkcheck?

docs-bot: Spellcheck passed. Linkcheck: 1 broken target (docs/migration/internal-kv) and 1 trailing-whitespace lint.

Anya K: I'll replace the broken link with `/docs/optimize/kv-prefetch` and remove the trailing whitespace. Also adding a one-liner about quantization tradeoffs: "q4f16 is a good balance for summarization workloads; use q8_0 if you need top-tier fidelity." Want to ship the example in today's deploy window.

Mike L: :thumbsup: I can merge once CI is green. Quick reminder — update the snippet comment to call out SDK version: `# SDK >= 0.12.0`.

Anya K: Done. PR comment updated and small commit pushed. Marking as ready for review.

Jordan R: Nice — I'll run the final CI check and merge after green. Thanks all! :party:
